ideas.pitch: An intelligent graph-intelligence and ML platform for detecting agricultural subsidy fraud and illicit supply chain fund flows in India.
ideas.title: AgriGraph AML & Subsidy Integrity Platform
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts the graph-intelligence and LightGBM AML architecture from the Bito win to solve a real Indian agricultural and financial problem, providing judges with concrete economic utility.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight computer vision mobile web tool utilizing MediaPipe Pose to evaluate rural pediatric motor milestones and basic postural health.
ideas.title: MediaPipe Rural Healthcare Triage Coach
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the proven MediaPipe confidence-gating approach from CricketVision_AI while tackling a localized developmental and healthcare problem relevant to India.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered meal analysis assistant fine-tuned on regional Indian diets and traditional grains to deliver hyper-localized nutritional insights.
ideas.title: NutriLok AI Localized Dietary Analyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the successful nutrition-assistant winning pattern from E-Foodiee while solving specific dietary and nutritional tracking challenges for Indian students.

ideas.pitch: An automated satellite imagery analysis tool that flags unauthorized industrial land encroachment and environmental degradation in developing zones.
ideas.title: EcoWatch Satellite Land Encroachment Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly mirrors the runner-up strategy of GeoNex-ATLAS by applying geospatial computer vision to a high-impact environmental monitoring use case.

ideas.pitch: A low-latency multilingual voice and text chatbot that surfaces hyperlocal public health advisories, vaccination schedules, and symptom triage in regional Indian languages.
ideas.title: ArogyaVani Multilingual Health Outbreak Bot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the exact winning formula of SAGACITY by addressing community health awareness with localized language support, which immediately resonates with judging panels.
